verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Make has an app/connection model. It documents app components (connections, modules, webhooks), team-level connections managed via API, and Skills for configuring modules and connecting to third-party services. Nothing in the pack establishes a catalog of thousands of prebuilt apps or says the integrations are vendor-maintained. missing for 10: evidence of a large prebuilt app catalog (thousands of apps), evidence that integrations are built and maintained by Make, documentation of the prebuilt connector library itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.
